cases.proves_bugs: BUG-697 (CD, E, pick a plain polyline you drew: the New Pipe window opens and a CE pipe is made; CE does not say "That line is already a CE pipe" and does not cancel)
cases.title: CD with E (Existing line) on a plain polyline you drew opens New Pipe (it does not say the line is already a CE pipe), and Start Pipe makes one CE pipe along it
cases.plan_item: CD Existing line (triage group N4; daily card D04 neighbour); BUG-697
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-697 in BUG_CARPARK.md (steps: CD, answer E, pick a plain polyline you drew on layer BLOCKS; actual: "[CE] That line is already a CE pipe. Double-click it to change it. Nothing was changed." and "CD command cancelled"; the pipe window never opens). BUG-684 (arcs and closed polylines) is in R39b, BUG-187 and BUG-874 are not driven.
cases.expected: After typing a 3-point open polyline on layer BLOCKS at 150000,-96000 / 155000,-96000 / 160000,-95000 and zooming to it, CD with the answer E and a point on the line opens the New Pipe window (and the command line does not say "already a CE pipe"); with the levels 18.000 and 17.900 and Start Pipe, CE places a pipe object (CeCvlPipeObject) whose label reads about "1 IN 101" (10.1 m long, 0.1 m fall) and the drawing holds IL texts 18.000 and 17.900. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The pick of the drawn line, the New Pipe window and the new pipe object only meet in a live CD run.
not_automated: What becomes of the source polyline after Start Pipe (kept or replaced) is recorded, not judged: the card does not say.
Arc and closed polylines (BUG-684) are in R39b. That the pipe follows the drawn line exactly (the same vertices) is not compared.
